blocks.html: Robinsons Communities Tops Off its Development in Pasig City

Robinsons Communities recently marked another milestone event as it topped off its development in Pasig City- Acacia Escalades. The topping-off of its first phase was held at the project site in Amang Rodriguez, corner Calle Industria, Brgy. Manggahan, Pasig City. The topping-off was led by (L-R) Arch. Henry Den Tee Chua, Stages Design Construction President; Mr. Ferdinand Adriano, Robinsons Communities Sales Head; Arch. Jerome Galarpe, Acacia Escalades Project Head; Ms. Mybelle V. Aragon-GoBio, Senior VP for Robinsons Luxuria, Residences and Communities; Mr. Edward Bernas, AVP for Business Development; Engr. Joel Jocson, RLC World Engineering; Arch. Butch Daza, ArkiAsia Principal Architect.

Acacia Escalades is a two-tower mid-rise development strategically located just a few minutes away from Eastwood City and surrounding business establishments. The residential enclave is also near prestigious schools and universities, making it an ideal residence for families and young professionals.
Acacia Escalades offers studio, one-bedroom, two-bedroom and three-bedroom units complemented with various amenities such as swimming pool, function rooms, gym, and children’s playground. The ground floor is dedicated to house dining and service shops, one of which is Robinsons Supermarket.
To know more about Acacia Escalades, visit the showroom located at Amang Rodriguez cor. Calle Industria, Manggahan, Pasig City. Or log on to www.robinsonscommunities.com or call Robinsons Communities sales hotlines at 248-5888 or 0925-800-0000.
